input.subject: Weekend Sale at the Coffee Shop – This Saturday & Sunday Only!
input.body:
Hi there,

Great news for coffee lovers: our weekend sale is on!

This Saturday and Sunday, stop by the shop and enjoy special savings on your favorite drinks, pastries, and fresh-roasted beans. Whether you're after your usual morning espresso, a cozy afternoon treat, or a bag of beans to take home, now's the perfect time to stock up.

What to expect:
- Special weekend pricing on select drinks and pastries
- Savings on retail bags of beans
- The same great coffee and friendly faces you know and love

Sale runs this weekend only, so don't miss out. We'd love to see you!

Warm regards,
The Coffee Shop Team

P.S. Know someone who loves coffee? Forward this email and bring them along!
